domestic_evidence: Screener.in standalone P&L for Goldstar Power Ltd (NSE-SME: GOLDSTAR), https://www.screener.in/company/GOLDSTAR/ : "Sales + 37.48 40.03 54.47 43.13 36.37 35.88 42.06 42.91 49.98 50.17 48.38 37.10 22.76" (Rs cr, FY2015-FY2026 + TTM) — i.e. FY2025 standalone sales Rs 48.38 cr, FY2026 Rs 37.10 cr, TTM Rs 22.76 cr; quarterly standalone sales Jun 2024 Rs 7.55 cr through Sep 2026 Rs 6.71 cr. Consolidated FY2026 sales Rs 838 cr / FY2025 Rs 48 cr (consolidation driven by Red Fire shipping/logistics acquisition per Screener key points). Company site (goldstarpower.com) states: "The Company caters all the three segments of market i.e. Exports, Domestic/After Market Sales and OEM" — this line is a claim, not evidence; the evidence is the audited standalone turnover series above, which is overwhelmingly domestic Indian battery sales. GSTIN-specific turnover band and GeM/CPPP tender awards: not retrieved (search engine unavailable during this run) — null.
note: Manufacturer (lead-acid battery plant at Rajkot Road, Hapa-361 120, Dist. Jamnagar, Gujarat; NSE-SME listed, CIN not verified in this run). Export shipments are factual, not merely declared: dated India customs/B-L records to Uganda (Jinja), Kenya (Mombasa), UAE (Jebel Ali) and Turkey/Afghanistan, Jan-Feb 2026, with B/L numbers. HS note: declared HS 850650 (lithium primary cells) does not match the observed export lines — actual codes seen are 85072000 (lead-acid storage batteries), 32064990, 84099990, 73071110, 48101990; the battery product line is 8507.20, so the code should be corrected to 85072000 (HS correction, not a rejection ground). Domestic supply confirmed by audited standalone turnover (Rs 48.38 cr FY2025, Rs 37.10 cr FY2026) — real Indian market sales, not just website wording. Caution: FY2026 consolidated revenue of Rs 838 cr comes from the Red Fire shipping/logistics consolidation, not from battery operations; battery standalone revenue is actually declining (-23% FY2026). Related-party export concentration is high — 329 of 503 shipments go to group entity Goldstar Battery (Uganda) Ltd, so a large share of exports is intra-group. No sanctions/court issues assessed here (out of scope for this role).
